_comment: Copy this to mcp.json to give the agent extra tools from external MCP servers.
Every tool is namespaced server__tool, so 'search' below becomes 'search__brave_web_search'.
A server that fails to start is skipped with a warning — it never blocks the trader.
After editing, run /mcp reload in Telegram (no restart needed).
Remove the entries you do not want. Each one spawns a process at boot.

fetch._note: Fetch a URL as markdown — useful for reading exchange announcements.

memory._note: Knowledge graph memory. The agent already has Neon memory; this is extra.

filesystem._note: Read/write files in one directory. Scope it tightly.

sequential-thinking._note: Structured step-by-step reasoning for hard calls.

python._note: Any MCP server, any language — it just has to speak stdio JSON-RPC.
